## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD3 (template half): digital-service-orchestra-nextjs-template's checked-in dso-config.conf contains merge.strategy=direct and enforcement.strategy=local

## Implementation

External repo: navapbc/digital-service-orchestra-nextjs-template

Add to that repo's checked-in dso-config.conf (typically at .claude/dso-config.conf in the template):
  merge.strategy=direct
  enforcement.strategy=local

Open a GitHub PR to that repo. Record the PR URL as a comment on ticket 0f6e-9b79.

This task is async (human-gate): task is complete when the PR is opened and URL recorded. Merge is pending reviewer approval.

## TDD Requirement
No local test: this is a config file change in an external repo. No executable behavior to assert locally (behavioral-testing-standard.md: requires observable behavior; absent here for an external static config). This is a human-gate task.

Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show 0f6e-9b79 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'navapbc/digital-service-orchestra-nextjs-template'

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] PR opened to navapbc/digital-service-orchestra-nextjs-template with merge.strategy=direct and enforcement.strategy=local added to dso-config.conf
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show 0f6e-9b79 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'navapbc/digital-service-orchestra-nextjs-template'
- [ ] PR URL recorded as a comment on ticket 0f6e-9b79

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet->opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Open PR to navapbc/digital-service-orchestra-nextjs-template to add merge strategy defaults to dso-config.conf
